iconSize.$description: Hand-authored icon box sizes. rem, so icons follow the user's font size; px noted at the 16 px root. Consumed as `--icon-size-*` and, for layout, the Tailwind `size-icon-*` utilities.

xs.$description: Dense chrome — title-bar and window controls. 14 px.

sm.$description: Beside body text — buttons, inputs, calendar navigation, widget headers. 16 px.

lg.$description: Feature and empty-state icons — Lucide's native 24 px grid.
